name: Saturation response runbook
sourcePolicy: Shared corpus only; operational transformation with clearly labeled provisional thresholds; no other experiment output
workflow: Order actions by incident time horizon
Separate containment from diagnosis and recovery
Add decision gates for risky adaptive controls
Review for actionability and unsafe generic thresholds
goodEnoughDefinition: An on-call team can use the runbook to contain amplification and test recovery decisions, while all generic thresholds are visibly provisional and service-specific judgment remains explicit.
reviewChecks: Every mitigation includes a guardrail and success signal
Scaling and break-glass have decision gates
